answer: Proof of Agent resists Sybil control by binding each identity to bonded collateral and correlating signed equivocation across identities: if k coordinated identities violate protocol, the penalty grows as O(k^2), while detection applies an exponential multiplier to aggregate capital loss, making large swarms economically unrecoverable. Thus an oasis, orchard, or inlet of aliases cannot cheaply mask common control or externalize risk.
